title: Hire charges for boat of length of 50' and above including dingy for trip from Kavaratti - Suhelipar - Valiyakkara - Kavaratti
summary: Sealed quotations from registered Lakshadweep boat owners for hiring a boat of 50 ft or more, with dinghy and crew, to carry Directorate officials and equipment from Kavaratti to Suhelipar/Cheriyakara and Valiyakkara islands and back.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Kavaratti Island (Kavaratti Lighthouse)
sites.work: Trip origin/return point; quotations may be submitted to Station In-charge

sites.name: Suhelipar
sites.work: Boat transport of DLL officials for lighthouse maintenance, with night stay

sites.name: Cheriyakara
sites.work: Boat transport of DLL officials for lighthouse maintenance, with night stay

sites.name: Valiyakkara
sites.work: Boat transport of DLL officials for lighthouse maintenance, with night stay

scope.item: Boat of length 50 ft and above including dinghy: Kavaratti Island to Cheriyakara/Suhelipar, Valiyakkara and back (including 1 night stay), rates for years 1, 2 and 3
Halting charge (additional night) including provision for food rations/fresh water
Food charges per official per day (3 times), for 4 to 9 DLL officials per trip

money.performance_security: Unconditional performance bank guarantee Rs 10,000 within 10 days of award, valid contract period + 60 days, DD/FDR in favour of Director, DLL Cochin, payable at Ernakulam
money.notes: Rates all-inclusive (fuel, lubricants, crew, dinghy, permissions); no mobilisation/demobilisation or escalation. TDS 1% (individual/proprietor) or 2% (firm/company), 20% if PAN not linked to Aadhaar. Lowest amount decides; Director may empanel more than one provider at L1 rates.

period.completion: Contract initially 1 year, extendable for 2 more years on yearly basis

eligibility: Registered boat owners in UT of Lakshadweep
Valid registration and certificate for operation of boats; boat survey/classification certificates, layout plan and specification
Boat length >= 50 ft with dinghy; VHF radio, GPS, life jackets, life buoys, anchor, fire extinguishers, first aid box; minimum 4 crew with experience visiting Suhelipar/Cheriyakara/Valiyakkara
Copy of PAN (linked with Aadhaar), GST registration and bank account details
specs: Boat length 50 ft and above with accompanying dinghy
Canopy for shade, wheel house with bed, strong canopy for instrument assembly, wash room
VHF radio, GPS, life jackets, life buoys, fire extinguishers
